messages:
elena: Heads-up — PM asks whether we can fold the embeddings cache precompute into MVP for the customer search pilot. They said it's blocking for latency targets. Proposed compromise below.
jon: For search latency, prefix cache hits drop p95 from ~450ms to ~130ms. If we're aiming for 200ms p95 for pilot, emb cache moves us there. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
maya: customer requested precomputed vectors for ~10M docs. Storage + ETL will be nontrivial. Also need refresh policy.
praveen: infra note — storing 10M embeddings in s3 + Redis index looks fine cost-wise, but warm-up + recompute on updates could spike compute. Suggest start with incremental windowed refresh.
taylor: If we push this to v1, we risk missing SLAs for pilot demos. Could we ship a limited-scope emb-cache MVP (tenant opt-in, 1M docs cap)?
elena: That's the compromise I was going to propose: emb-cache MVP = opt-in, 1M doc cap, eventual full rollout in v1. That buys infra time and keeps pilot latency.
jon: Agreed. Also suggests a feature-flag so Dedicated customers can enable larger caps immediately.
praveen: Feature flag + quota enforcement is doable. Need an estimate: cost + infra ops for opt-in plan. I'll add to infra todo.
maya: SSO + tenant-RBAC that we were planning for MVP — can we postpone to v1? Customer isn't asking for that immediately.
taylor: We probably should keep basic SSO (SSO login) in MVP, but defer advanced cross-tenant RBAC and provisioning integrations to v1.
elena: Decision check — MVP scope: basic SSO, emb-cache opt-in (1M cap), feature-flag for Dedicated scale, postpone tenant-RBAC/provisioning to v1. Anyone blocking?
jon: Not blocking. Need a small API contract for emb-cache enablement. I'll write a tiny PR.
praveen: I'll estimate infra ops and post numbers by EOD tomorrow.
maya: I'll update the pilot runbook and customer comms. Need to add rollback steps.
pm-bot: @elena updated launch criteria doc: https://redwood.docs/launch/mvp-criteria — added emb-cache opt-in and SSO basics.
elena: Thanks. Quick follow-up — can someone add the new acceptance criteria lines:
```
- Emb-cache opt-in route with 1M doc cap
- Feature-flag for Dedicated scale
- Basic SSO enabled (no cross-tenant RBAC)
- Rollback plan for emb-cache (disable flag)
```
jon: I'll open the PR with the acceptance criteria and small API sketch.
praveen: FYI I set a quick perf test: local sim shows 1M cap warm-up ~ 20min on ci-gpu. Will iterate.
taylor: tagging this as decision made. We'll track in the milestone board.
elena: Great. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
